* GET_STARTED
Greeting message and Data Privacy Notice
* USER_AGREES
Postback direct to main system [REVIEW_MENU]
* REVIEW_MENU
Handles Displaying Menu Categories
* VIEW_POPULAR, FT, MT, SIGNATURES, BITES
Handles Displaying Menu Items
* SELECT_SIZE
Prompts user to select available drink sizes
* SELECT_ADD_ON
Prompts user to select available add-ons
* HANDLE_BITES & VIEW_CART
Handle To-Add Bites Item and directs after 'SELECT_ADD_ON'
* CLEAR_CART
Clear Cart Function
* END_SESSION
End Session Function

# N8N Python Node - HTML to Image Converter # This replaces the HTTP Request node with a free, unlimited solution import base64 import io from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont from html import unescape import re import json # Get the HTML from previous node html_content = _input.first()['json']['receiptHTML'] def html_to_image_simple(html_content, width=400, height=800): """ Simple HTML to image converter using PIL Extracts text content and creates a styled receipt image """ # Extract text content from HTML (remove tags) def strip_html_tags(html): clean = re.compile('<.*?>') return re.sub(clean, '', html) # Parse key information from HTML lines = [] # Extract content between specific divs/classes content_match = re.search(r'
(.*?)
\s*\s*', html_content, re.DOTALL) if content_match: content = content_match.group(1) # Extract title title_match = re.search(r'
(.*?)
', content) if title_match: lines.append(('title', strip_html_tags(title_match.group(1)))) # Extract order info order_info_match = re.search(r'
(.*?)
', content, re.DOTALL) if order_info_match: order_info = strip_html_tags(order_info_match.group(1)).replace('\n', ' ').strip() lines.append(('info', order_info)) # Extract items items_match = re.search(r'
(.*?)
', content, re.DOTALL) if items_match: items_html = items_match.group(1) # Find all item blocks item_blocks = re.findall(r'
(.*?)
(?=\s*
|$)', items_html, re.DOTALL) for item_block in item_blocks: # Extract item name and total header_match = re.search(r'(.*?).*?(.*?)', item_block) if header_match: item_name = strip_html_tags(header_match.group(1)) item_total = strip_html_tags(header_match.group(2)) lines.append(('item', f"{item_name} - {item_total}")) # Extract item details details_match = re.search(r'
(.*?)
', item_block) if details_match: details = strip_html_tags(details_match.group(1)) lines.append(('details', f" {details}")) # Extract addons addons = re.findall(r'
(.*?)
', item_block) for addon in addons: addon_text = strip_html_tags(addon) lines.append(('addon', f" {addon_text}")) # Extract totals totals_match = re.search(r'
(.*?)
', content, re.DOTALL) if totals_match: totals_html = totals_match.group(1) # Extract total rows total_rows = re.findall(r'
.*?(.*?).*?(.*?).*?
', totals_html) for row in total_rows: label = strip_html_tags(row[0]) amount = strip_html_tags(row[1]) lines.append(('total', f"{label}: {amount}")) # Extract final total final_match = re.search(r'
.*?(.*?).*?(.*?).*?
', totals_html) if final_match: label = strip_html_tags(final_match.group(1)) amount = strip_html_tags(final_match.group(2)) lines.append(('final_total', f"{label}: {amount}")) # Extract order details details_match = re.search(r'
(.*?)
', content, re.DOTALL) if details_match: details_html = details_match.group(1) detail_rows = re.findall(r'
.*?(.*?).*?(.*?).*?
', details_html) for row in detail_rows: label = strip_html_tags(row[0]) value = strip_html_tags(row[1]) lines.append(('detail', f"{label} {value}")) # Extract thank you message thank_match = re.search(r'
(.*?)
', content) if thank_match: thank_you = strip_html_tags(thank_match.group(1)) lines.append(('thank_you', thank_you)) # Create image img = Image.new('RGB', (width, height), 'white') draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img) # Try to use system fonts, fallback to default try: font_title = ImageFont.truetype("/System/Library/Fonts/Helvetica.ttc", 24) font_header = ImageFont.truetype("/System/Library/Fonts/Helvetica.ttc", 18) font_normal = ImageFont.truetype("/System/Library/Fonts/Helvetica.ttc", 14) font_small = ImageFont.truetype("/System/Library/Fonts/Helvetica.ttc", 12) except: try: font_title = ImageFont.truetype("arial.ttf", 24) font_header = ImageFont.truetype("arial.ttf", 18) font_normal = ImageFont.truetype("arial.ttf", 14) font_small = ImageFont.truetype("arial.ttf", 12) except: font_title = ImageFont.load_default() font_header = ImageFont.load_default() font_normal = ImageFont.load_default() font_small = ImageFont.load_default() # Draw header background draw.rectangle([0, 0, width, 80], fill='#1a1a1a') # Draw logo and tagline draw.text((width//2, 25), "BLESSINGS CAFE", font=font_header, fill='white', anchor='mm') draw.text((width//2, 50), "Fresh • Quality • Delicious", font=font_small, fill='white', anchor='mm') # Draw border draw.rectangle([10, 10, width-10, height-50], outline='black', width=2) y_pos = 100 padding = 20 for line_type, text in lines: if y_pos > height - 100: # Prevent overflow break if line_type == 'title': draw.text((width//2, y_pos), text, font=font_header, fill='#1a1a1a', anchor='mm') y_pos += 30 elif line_type == 'info': draw.text((width//2, y_pos), text, font=font_small, fill='#666', anchor='mm') y_pos += 25 elif line_type == 'item': # Draw item on two lines if too long if len(text) > 35: words = text.split(' - ') draw.text((padding, y_pos), words[0], font=font_normal, fill='black') draw.text((width - padding, y_pos), words[1] if len(words) > 1 else '', font=font_normal, fill='black', anchor='rm') else: draw.text((padding, y_pos), text, font=font_normal, fill='black') y_pos += 22 elif line_type == 'details': draw.text((padding, y_pos), text, font=font_small, fill='#666') y_pos += 18 elif line_type == 'addon': draw.text((padding, y_pos), text, font=font_small, fill='#888') y_pos += 18 elif line_type == 'total': parts = text.split(': ') if len(parts) == 2: draw.text((padding, y_pos), parts[0] + ':', font=font_normal, fill='black') draw.text((width - padding, y_pos), parts[1], font=font_normal, fill='black', anchor='rm') y_pos += 20 elif line_type == 'final_total': # Draw line above final total draw.line([padding, y_pos-5, width-padding, y_pos-5], fill='black', width=2) y_pos += 10 parts = text.split(': ') if len(parts) == 2: draw.text((padding, y_pos), parts[0] + ':', font=font_header, fill='black') draw.text((width - padding, y_pos), parts[1], font=font_header, fill='black', anchor='rm') y_pos += 35 elif line_type == 'detail': draw.text((width//2, y_pos), text, font=font_small, fill='#333', anchor='mm') y_pos += 18 elif line_type == 'thank_you': draw.text((width//2, y_pos), text, font=font_normal, fill='#1a1a1a', anchor='mm') y_pos += 30 # Add footer draw.text((width//2, height-30), "© 2025 Blessings Cafe", font=font_small, fill='#999', anchor='mm') # Crop image to actual content height actual_height = min(y_pos + 50, height) img = img.crop((0, 0, width, actual_height)) return img # Generate the image try: receipt_image = html_to_image_simple(html_content) # Convert to base64 buffer = io.BytesIO() receipt_image.save(buffer, format='PNG', quality=95, optimize=True) img_base64 = base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode() # Create data URL image_data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{img_base64}" return { "json": { "senderId": _input.first()['json']['senderId'], "image_base64": img_base64, "image_data_url": image_data_url, "image_size": len(buffer.getvalue()), "status": "success" } } except Exception as e: return { "json": { "senderId": _input.first()['json']['senderId'], "error": str(e), "status": "failed" } } # Requirements for n8n Python node: # pip install Pillow
